prompt: Subject: Windowside gazing at a white rose Main Focus: woman in her 20s kneeling with one knee on a beige sofa by a bright window, gazing at a single white rose. Large focus on character in center-right, featuring the white thin-strap mini dress and the hand holding the flower. Person/Expression: Slender oval profile, downcast dark brown eyes, thin eyebrows, small nose tip, pale coral lips. Head tilted down-left with a calm expression looking at the rose. Hair nearly black tied low, leaving thin bangs and long strands along cheeks. Clothing/Pose: white thin-strap bodycon mini dress. Clear view of shallow V-neck, chest stitching, and fine horizontal wrinkles from waist to hem. Layered wide gold choker and thin necklace. Left leg bent on the sofa arm, standing on right leg. Right hand holding the rose stem, left arm lowered behind back. Background/Light: Large window with white lace curtains on the right, grey wall on the left with black geometric pendant and wood wall lamp, beige sofa below. Soft daylight from the right illuminates skin and white cloth, casting faint warm shadows on the left. Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical. Thigh-up portrait from a front camera at eye level. Character large on the right half, rose in top-left, bent left leg extending bottom-left. Right leg and left knee cut at the bottom. Focus on face and rose with light background blur. Texture/Style: Photorealistic photo in natural window light. Detailed depiction of natural skin texture, thin wrinkles in white cloth, rose petals, metal accessories, and light through curtains. Negative: Alteration of posture with knee on sofa; omission of white rose.

promptZh: 主体：窗边凝视白玫瑰 核心焦点：20 多岁的女性 单膝跪在明亮窗边的米色沙发上，凝视着一朵白玫瑰。画面重心位于中右侧，重点展示白色细肩带迷你裙以及手持花朵的动作。人物/表情：纤细的椭圆形侧脸，深棕色眼眸低垂，眉毛细长，鼻尖小巧，嘴唇呈淡珊瑚色。头部向左下方倾斜，表情平静地注视着玫瑰。近乎黑色的头发低扎，留有细碎刘海和垂在脸颊两侧的长发丝。服装/姿势：白色细肩带紧身迷你裙。清晰可见浅 V 领、胸部缝线以及从腰部到下摆的细微横向褶皱。佩戴叠层宽金项圈和细项链。左腿弯曲在沙发扶手上，右腿站立。右手握住玫瑰花茎，左臂垂在身后。背景/光影：右侧是大窗户配白色蕾丝窗帘，左侧是灰色墙壁，挂有黑色几何吊坠和木质壁灯，下方为米色沙发。来自右侧的柔和日光照亮了皮肤和白色衣物，在左侧投下淡淡的暖色阴影。构图/相机：3:4 竖构图。平视角度拍摄的半身人像。人物位于画面右半部分，玫瑰位于左上方，弯曲的左腿延伸至左下方。右腿和左膝在底部被裁切。焦点集中在面部和玫瑰上，背景有轻微虚化。质感/风格：自然窗光下的写实摄影。细腻呈现真实的皮肤纹理、白色衣物的细微褶皱、玫瑰花瓣、金属配饰以及穿过窗帘的光影。负面提示：改变单膝跪在沙发上的姿势；遗漏白玫瑰。
